## Orientation

Wave 3 is the verification task. It depends on `replace-resolvers` and `close-library`, which are already on `phase/orchestra-callers`. Run the checks. Do not edit the tree and do not open a task branch.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/orchestra-callers` on `phase/orchestra-callers`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together. R3: `orchestra/aa_resolve.py` is not in the tree. R8: `orchestra --help` exits 0 when affidavit is not importable. R9: a close that needs affidavit names affidavit when it is missing.

## Approach

Run the three checks in the phase worktree. Do not edit the tree and do not open a task branch. The help check and the missing-affidavit close check go through the real orchestra entry point.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R3: `orchestra/aa_resolve.py` is not in the tree.
R8: `orchestra --help` exits 0 when affidavit is not importable.
R9: A close that needs affidavit raises an error that names affidavit when affidavit is not importable.

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

Help does not import affidavit. No orchestra or dashboard module resolves `SE_WORKFLOW_STORE` or a private binding file.

## Assumptions

The dashboard process runs with the orchestra environment, so one dependency covers both trees.

orchestra-imports choice: direct-imports
call-style choice: python-imports-libraries
dependency-direction choice: affidavit-on-aa-orchestra-on-both
store-resolution choice: open-store-in-adaptive-artifacts
